connector.name: Openemis Pro
connector.registryDescription: Read + write MCP server for OpenEMIS - free open-source school management system. 675 resources.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package openemis-mcp-pro. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tixuz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENEMIS_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of your OpenEMIS instance (e.g., https://demo.openemis.org/core)

env.name: OPENEMIS_API_KEY
env.description: OpenEMIS API key (issued by the OpenEMIS admin). Required for every upstream login.

env.name: OPENEMIS_USERNAME
env.description: OpenEMIS login username. Optional — if unset, server fails closed and requires openemis_login at runtime.

env.name: OPENEMIS_PASSWORD
env.description: OpenEMIS login password. Pairs with OPENEMIS_USERNAME for env-default auth.

env.name: OPENEMIS_CORE_IN_OPERATOR
env.description: Set to 1 to enable native IN-operator batch GETs once your OpenEMIS Core has POCOR-9660 deployed.
